meta.source: DHRUV 'Polar light' palette (team decision replacing the Bible §17 dark palette); apps/web/src/styles/theme.css

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every surface; cool grey so white cards separate on a projector.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, drawers, top bar, sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Table headers, the synthetic-data banner, hover fills, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline, chart gridlines, timeline connectors.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders: 4.3:1 on surface, 3.7:1 on surface-elevated.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, values and headings on bg, surface, surface-elevated and every tint (14.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, ages, captions on bg, surface, surface-elevated and every tint (5.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Quieter metadata (device ids, tick labels, footnotes) on bg, surface, surface-elevated and every tint (4.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: state-green
tokens.usage: GREEN: sufficient. Always with the word GREEN and a check icon. 5.9:1 on surface, 5.1:1 or better on every ground and tint.

tokens.name: state-amber
tokens.usage: AMBER: attention, aging, uncertainty, verify. Always with the word and a triangle icon. 6.0:1 on surface, 5.1:1 or better on every ground and tint.

tokens.name: state-red
tokens.usage: RED: below threshold or blocked. Always with the word and an octagon icon. 5.7:1 on surface, 4.9:1 or better on every ground and tint. Green and red are close in lightness: never rely on hue alone.

tokens.name: state-green-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind a GREEN badge or a GREEN approval confirmation.

tokens.name: state-amber-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind AMBER badges, verify gates, straddle flags, pending-sync counter.

tokens.name: state-red-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind RED badges, RED dimension chips, PNR strip, incident strip.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Actions, selection, links (Show the math), focus ring, now-marker. Interaction only, never a state. 5.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected nav item and selected scenario ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, Check in): 5.9:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element: 5.9:1 on surface.

styles.name: trace
styles.usage: Trace lines, formulas, ids, timestamps, coordinates.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Product name in the top bar; no logo exists.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit; icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip grid gaps, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding, card grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; column gutters.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Large panel and station card padding; screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large panel padding upper bound.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, tier badges, freshness chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, dimension chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and drawers. Maximum radius in the system.

tokens.name: drawer-shadow
tokens.usage: Only on right-hand drawers (trace, sync, what-if). Elevation is otherwise borders and contrast.
